{
    "sla_rules": [
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_001",
            "metric": "AvailabilityImpactPercentage",
            "threshold": 99.0,
            "threshold_operator": "<",
            "penalty_amount": 500,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 5,
            "description": "5% penalty if Availability Impact exceeds 99%",
            "applicable_period": "per incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_002",
            "metric": "QueryFailureRatePercentage",
            "threshold": 1.0,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 200,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 2,
            "description": "2% penalty if Query Failure Rate exceeds 1%",
            "applicable_period": "per incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_003",
            "metric": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes",
            "threshold": 5.0,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 300,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 3,
            "description": "3% penalty if Initial Response Time exceeds 5 minutes",
            "applicable_period": "per incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_004",
            "metric": "RecoveryTimeMinutes",
            "threshold": 60.0,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 1000,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 10,
            "description": "10% penalty if Recovery Time exceeds 60 minutes",
            "applicable_period": "per incident"
        }
    ],
    "violation_conditions": [
        {
            "metric": "SLABreached",
            "condition": "SLABreached = 'True'",
            "penalty_rule": "Apply respective penalties based on breach details"
        }
    ],
    "sql_query": "SELECT DetectedAt, CASE WHEN AvailabilityImpactPercentage >= 99 THEN 500 WHEN QueryFailureRatePercentage > 1 THEN 200 WHEN InitialResponseTimeMinutes > 5 THEN 300 WHEN RecoveryTimeMinutes > 60 THEN 1000 ELSE 0 END AS PenaltyAmount FROM incidents_database_service WHERE SLABreached = 'True' ORDER BY DetectedAt",
    "data_fields_required": ["DetectedAt", "AvailabilityImpactPercentage", "QueryFailureRatePercentage", "InitialResponseTimeMinutes", "RecoveryTimeMinutes", "SLABreached"],
    "monthly_service_fee": 10000,
    "max_monthly_penalty_percentage": 30
}
